basic_details.job_title: Burari Hospital Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: Burari Hospital has announced 7 contract vacancies for Senior Resident (Anaesthesia) and Senior Resident (Pathology) posts under its 2026 recruitment. Candidates applying for these positions must submit an online application by the last date of 16 November 2026. Applicants must possess the required post-graduate qualification and registration with the Delhi Medical Council, with appointment terms initially for a period of 44 days or till a regular candidate joins, up to a maximum of three years. content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the Burari Hospital Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 16-11-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Burari Hospital to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Burari Hospital, Delhi, for filling up medical positions in various specialties on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in Burari Hospital Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts are Senior Resident in Anaesthesia and Pathology departments, with a total of 7 vacancies announced.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an MBBS degree along with a Post Graduate Degree, DNB, or Diploma in the concerned medical specialty from a recognized university or institute.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 19 October 2026, starting between 9 AM and 11 AM at the office of the Medical Director.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for these positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 45 years, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories such as SC, ST, and OBC as per rules.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are there for Senior Resident Anaesthesia?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies available for the Senior Resident (Anaesthesia) post across different categories.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is specified in the official notification for applying to these contract posts.

faq.question: Q9. What is the duration of the contract appointment?
faq.answer: The appointment is initially for a period of 44 days or until a regular candidate joins, with a maximum tenure of up to three years.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required at the time of the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring a printed application form, DMC registration, degree certificates, attempt certificate, class 10 certificate, ID proof, and passport-size photographs.
